d: We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused English Call Center Agent (CX) to join our team. As a CX Agent, you will play a key role in ensuring that our clients have a seamless and positive experience with our team. You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and optimizing the end-to-end customer journey. This role requires a proactive, solutions-oriented individual who is fluent in English and has a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
q: Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
Bachelor's degree with an English Background is a plus.
1-3 years of experience in customer service, customer experience
Experience with customer service platforms, CRM tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Capacity to handle challenging situations with professionalism and empathy.
Strong customer service orientation with a passion for delivering high-quality solutions.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
r: Design and implement customer journey mapping to optimize the end-to-end customer experience, identifying pain points and opportunities for improvement.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring that their needs are fully understood and addressed in a timely manner to meet and exceed expectations.
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer feedback is used to enhance products.
Maintain a high standard of customer service by addressing all inquiries and issues with professionalism and empathy.
Ensure a positive experience for customers at all touchpoints, from initial contact through to resolution and follow-up.
Monitor and track performance metrics, such as response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, ensuring consistent improvement.

d: We are seeking an experienced, creative, and highly organised Event Manager / Festival Operations Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of events, festivals, concerts, exhibitions, and large-scale entertainment activities. The successful candidate will oversee end-to-end event operations, manage budgets and logistics, coordinate vendors and stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of events while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and audience experience.
Develop, plan, and execute events, festivals, concerts, exhibitions, and promotional activities.
Manage the complete event lifecycle, from concept development and planning to execution and post-event evaluation.
Coordinate event logistics, including venue arrangements, staging, lighting, sound systems, equipment, transportation, and accommodation.
Develop event budgets, monitor expenditure, and ensure effective cost control.
Liaise with sponsors, suppliers, vendors, performers, artists, government representatives, and business partners.
Supervise event staff, contractors, volunteers, and operational teams.
Oversee venue preparation, event setup, dismantling, and on-site operations.
Develop event schedules, operational plans, contingency arrangements, and emergency response procedures.
Monitor crowd management, security coordination, health and safety, and operational risks.
Ensure all event activities meet quality standards and agreed project objectives.
Manage sponsorship agreements, strategic partnerships, and commercial opportunities.
Resolve operational challenges and make timely decisions to ensure smooth event delivery.
Monitor event performance, audience feedback, and operational efficiency.
Prepare post-event reports and recommend improvements for future events.
Lead, motivate, and develop event operations teams to achieve project objectives and deadlines.
Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in event management, festival operations, entertainment, or large-scale event coordination.
Proven experience managing major events, festivals, concerts, exhibitions, or public gatherings.
Strong knowledge of event planning, production, logistics, budgeting, and on-site operations.
Experience managing suppliers, contractors, sponsors, performers, and multiple stakeholders.
Good understanding of crowd management, security coordination, emergency planning, and event risk management.
Strong leadership, project management, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent organisational, communication, and interpersonal abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under pressure.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant event management software.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Excellent command of written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
